title: Alignment child process exceeded its deadline during concurrent validation
symptom: The final repository suite reported 570 passed, 5 skipped and 1 failed. alignment-only.test.ts:178 received a null child exitCode under a fixed 20-second deadline while packaging and installation checks also ran. On 2026-10-22 KST, candidate CI macOS timed out the member-boundary-comment test after 60034 ms with one dangling process killed and first.exitCode null.

rootCause.summary: The execution deadline was observed again in a candidate macOS CI suite, now at 60 seconds in a matrix-boundary CLI child. Concurrent validation load alone is not established as the cause. The child/server stage responsible remains under investigation.

requestedOutcome: Identify and bound the recurring CLI child-process stall with a repeatable trigger, then verify its correction without hiding failures or simply increasing the deadline.
decisions: Retain the original timeout and full-suite failure as an observed result.
Run the unchanged targeted suite and then the full suite with expensive validation serialized.
Keep the deadline and implementation unchanged while investigating; a retry does not erase the failed attempt.

actions.description: Capture the failing full-suite output and run the unchanged targeted test suite.
Finish serialized full-suite validation and record its result.
Investigate the underlying deadline cause if it recurs during serialized validation; concurrent load remains an unconfirmed hypothesis.

The unchanged targeted retry and serialized full suite passed. Root cause beyond the observed child deadline is not confirmed; investigation is deferred pending recurrence. This does not claim a product fix or prove load caused the timeout.

Reopened after a candidate macOS CI recurrence at a 60-second deadline. Preserve the earlier local pass; investigate with the exact member-comment CLI input and bounded repeated execution rather than increasing timeouts.

Direct CLI 640 runs and filtered test 200 runs did not fail. One initial full-file run exceeded a 30-second outer watchdog without stage capture; 120 captured p4 and 80 captured p8 full-file runs passed. The early stall is not proven identical to CI. Root cause remains unknown; no runtime/test/deadline changes were made. Future recurrence needs API-stage and child-reaping evidence.
